scenes.headline: How a laptop model grows its own experts
scenes.sub: mini-AGI: a byte-level model that keeps learning while it reads.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Fern! mini-AGI is a byte-level model that trains on one eight-gigabyte laptop card and grows its own experts.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Experts live on disk. A slow router puts 32 on the card per passage, a fast one picks 8 per character, and the pool keeps growing.
scenes.say: The experts live on disk. A slow router loads thirty-two per passage, a fast one picks eight per character, and the pool keeps growing.

steps.say: Every expert is a small MLP, stored as a file on disk. The published snapshot had a hundred and sixty-nine.
Once every two thousand and forty-eight characters, a slow segment router chooses which thirty-two sit on the card.
Each character runs one shared block up to twenty-four times. On every pass, a fast router picks eight of those thirty-two.

scenes.title: How the pool grows and shrinks

items.say: The pool may add at most one expert every two million characters, and brakes refuse about a third.
A newborn isn't a clone or a random init. It's assembled from whole hidden units taken from sixteen trained parents.
And an expert nothing loads for a hundred million characters is deleted, so the pool shrinks too.

scenes.title: One learning rate stops the forgetting

left.title: Trunk at full rate
items: Trunk: the part every character passes through
left.say: Read half a million characters of chess with the shared trunk at full learning rate, and the seven unread subjects get two point two three nats worse.

right.title: Trunk at one tenth
items: Forgetting falls below the noise floor
right.say: Slow only the trunk to a tenth, and forgetting falls below the probe's noise floor. That is the honest reading of zero point zero zero six seven.

scenes.text: The finding is one multiplier: slow the shared trunk's learning rate, and single-subject forgetting goes from catastrophic to unmeasurable.
scenes.say: The finding is one multiplier. Slow the shared trunk's learning rate, and forgetting goes from catastrophic to unmeasurable.

recap: A slow router pages 32 experts onto the card
A fast router picks 8 of them per character
A slower trunk keeps forgetting below the noise
scenes.say: To recap: a slow router pages experts in, a fast one picks eight, and a slower trunk stops forgetting.
